notablePrerequisites: There are at least five creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Voracious Brood by paying {2}, blinking it. Voracious Brood enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Voracious Brood enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Voracious Brood.
Activate Voracious Brood using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
